# Garrett G. Craig

> Garrett Craig's personal website: environmental science and conservation research, nature photography, trail journals, and tools for exploring the natural world.

The links below lead to the site's public pages. Trail journals also have plain Markdown versions; use the HTML pages for interactive maps and photographs.

## About

- [Garrett G. Craig](https://garrettgcraig.com/): Biography, interests, photography, research, and contact.

## Research

- [Research](https://garrettgcraig.com/research): Current and past work in conservation, climate, and ecological restoration.
- [Amazonian climate impacts](https://garrettgcraig.com/project-amazon-climate): Projected climate impacts in Indigenous Peoples' and Local Communities' territories.
- [Fossorial animal colonization](https://garrettgcraig.com/project-fossorial): Burrowing animals and ecological restoration.
- [Herpetofauna and restoration](https://garrettgcraig.com/project-herpetofauna): Reptile and amphibian responses to restoration.
- [Greenhouse gas emissions and eTRM](https://garrettgcraig.com/project-ghg-etrm): Standardizing emissions-savings calculations.

## Photography

- [Photography](https://garrettgcraig.com/photography): Nature photography galleries.
- [Wildlife](https://garrettgcraig.com/photography-wildlife): Wildlife photographs.
- [Landscapes](https://garrettgcraig.com/photography-landscapes): Landscape photographs.
- [Flora](https://garrettgcraig.com/photography-flora): Plant photographs.
- [Macro](https://garrettgcraig.com/photography-macro): Close-up photographs.

## Tools and projects

- [Projects](https://garrettgcraig.com/projects): Environmental data tools and applications.
- [Public lands tracker](https://garrettgcraig.com/wilderness): Interactive map of wilderness areas, national parks, and national forests, with visited-land tracking.
- [SeedFinder](https://garrettgcraig.com/seedfinder/): A map for exploring which plants may have collectible seed nearby.
- [KnowKi](https://garrettgcraig.com/knowki/): An app for learning local species by sight, with support information.
- [ChronoSono](https://garrettgcraig.com/chronosono/about/): A music timeline party game for phones, with how to play.
- [Santa Barbara wildlife crossings](https://garrettgcraig.com/wildlife-crossings/): Wildlife crossing priorities along Santa Barbara County's state highways.

## Trail journals

- [Trail log](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-log): Backpacking and hiking journals.
- [Big SEKI Loop — July 2026](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-big-seki-loop.md): Fifteen days through Kings Canyon and Sequoia, with a detour over Kearsarge Pass.
- [San Raf — Nira to Mission Pine Spring](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-san-raf-nira-to-mission-pine-spring.md): Three days up the Manzana and into the high country to Mission Pine Spring.
- [Sespe Wilderness — November 2025](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-sespe-2025.md): Four days in the Sespe, November 26–29, about 34 miles.
- [San Rafael Wilderness — March 2025](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-san-rafael-2025.md): Three days in the San Rafael Wilderness, March 26–28, about 44 miles.
- [Yosemite and the Eastern Sierra — August 2024](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-eastern-sierra-2024.md): Six days in Yosemite and the Eastern Sierra, August 23–28, about 42 miles.
- [Boundary Waters — July 2024](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-boundary-waters-2024.md): Four days in the Boundary Waters, July 24–27, about 43 miles.
- [Isle Royale — May 2024](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-isle-royale-2024.md): Seven days on Isle Royale, May 23–29, about 49 miles.
- [Great Smoky Mountains — April 2024](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-smokies-2024.md): Three days in the Smokies, April 26–28, about 42 miles.
- [Isle Royale — May 2023](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-isle-royale-2023.md): Nine days on Isle Royale, May 24–June 1, about 65 miles.
- [Colorado Trail — July 2022](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-colorado-trail-2022.md): Three days on the Colorado Trail, July 19–21, about 57 miles.
- [Sylvania Wilderness — June 2022](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-sylvania-2022.md): Seven days in the Sylvania Wilderness, June 26–July 2, about 42 miles.
- [Pictured Rocks — June 2022](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-pictured-rocks-2022.md): Four days along Pictured Rocks, June 17–20, about 43 miles.
- [Isle Royale — June 2022](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-isle-royale-2022.md): Seven days on Isle Royale, June 6–12, about 54 miles.
- [Great Smoky Mountains — June 2020](https://garrettgcraig.com/trail-smokies-2020.md): Four days in the Smokies, June 4–7, about 31 miles.
